flags.sentence: Diagnosis records match well nationally, but Itä-Uusimaa's crude treatment shares lack age or stage adjustment, and public data omit primary care, referrals, and treatment start dates.
flags.problem: Claim [bs:coverage:Primary_care_occupational_health] specifies that primary care visits are 'not included in the report's data' (and explicitly warns never to say 'excluded'), rather than being omitted from public data generally.

flags.sentence: A journal article found HILMO diagnoses match the Cancer Registry for about 90% of most cancer types (diagnosis concordance only), whereas reading Itä-Uusimaa's above-national crude 31.6% (95% CI 26.4–37.4; n=86/272) no-treatment-record share versus 27.5% (4089/14873) nationally as a data-quality signal suggests—as an inference, not a finding—that lower recorded treatment shares may partly reflect unrecorded treatment.
flags.problem: Claim [cty:no_treatment_record:Itä_Uudenmaan_hyvinvointialue] states that Itä-Uusimaa's 31.6% (95% CI 26.4–37.4) no-treatment-record share is 'not distinguishable vs national 27.5%'. Calling it 'above-national' without noting that its confidence interval includes the national benchmark overstates the comparison.
